page0.text:
"Rider. Was what Shinji said earlier true?"
I ask, not really expecting a response.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-03:page0:1

page1.text:
...
There's no change in Rider. Just her long hair fluttering in the wind.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-03:page1:1

page2.text:
"I figured as much. Sorry for asking such a stupid question when we're supposed to be enemies."
I step out through the door, raising my hand to show her my appreciation for seeing me out.
...But then.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-03:page2:1

page3.text: "He did not lie. There is a witch living in the mountains."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-03:page3:1

page4.text:
"Huh...? Rider?"
"You must proceed with caution if you intend to challenge her. That witch knows how the minds of men work."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-03:page4:1

page5.text:
Rider speaks indifferently.
I realize her voice is drawing me in, and shake my head to clear it.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-03:page5:1

page6.text:
"Uh...um...thanks for the warning.
And take good care of Shinji. As you can see, he's a bit of a pain, but I hope you can protect him."
I catch myself getting surprised, but I manage to reply.
I guess that was funny, because...
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-03:page6:1
